_doc: Contract versions (BACKEND ADR-07). JavaScript imports contracts/versions.js; this file mirrors it for other readers, and contracts/tests/contracts.test.mjs keeps the two equal. Bump the matching number in the same commit as any change: matcher behaviour -> MATCHER_VERSION; profile.schema.json or a band the profile uses -> PROFILE_V (and add a step to profile_migrations.js); slice.schema.json or skills_index.schema.json -> SLICE_V; api/*, events.schema.json or extract.schema.json -> API_V.
